facts.name: Robert Kyle Lambert
facts.assignment: Citrus circuit judge; profile supplies civil/foreclosure and domestic-relations scheduling. Full allocation is not stated on this profile and remains for county assignment reconciliation.

contact.contact_note: Office email is the published materials/order submission inbox, distinct from assistant questions/scheduling route. Office/assistant phone shared. Profile omits fax and roster fax field is blank; no personal judicial email established.

chambers_communications.summary: Contact assistant for procedural/scheduling questions; use separately published materials inbox where directed. No direct merits discussions with judge. Copy opposing counsel on cross-noticing requests.

hearing_scheduling.summary: OnceHub rather than telephone; coordinate sufficient total time, await approval and deliver courtesy notice to finalize. Separate links for uncontested foreclosure final hearings and other civil settings. If coordination fails, request court selection by motion documenting proposed options. Cross-noticing needs express office permission.

proposed_orders.summary: Profile directs general proposed orders through e-Portal, with no cover letter needed. Linked shared guide requires .docx, prescribed template/DJMCA codes, UCN and separate uploads; no exhibits/images in the order. Foreclosure paragraph separately directs final judgment/exhibits/questions by email; preserve that stated scope.

courtesy_copies.summary: Courtesy notice to court. Final materials block: at least one week before hearing, over ten pages by mail and ten or fewer by orders-inbox email. Separate remote-evidence and civil/foreclosure paragraphs state different time/route requirements, retained as source differences.

remote_appearances.summary: Approved general scheduling request produces Zoom link; evidentiary hearings are described as in person, with a conditional electronic-hearing route. Proper courtroom conduct and disclosure of others present required; court may reset noncompliant remote hearings in person.

cancellations.summary: Movant files cancellation and sends courtesy copy. Court-set hearings require dismissal/stipulated dismissal order or court order. Continuance consent alone does not guarantee approval.

case_management.summary: Send courtesy cause-at-issue notice to assistant. Profile describes nonjury pretrial scheduling conference; DR paragraph directs contact with assistant for conference after notice for trial. Detailed trial preparation not analyzed.

facts.summary: Civil/family profile uses OnceHub, office approval and courtesy notices; general proposed orders use the portal and Word templates. Keep separate materials inbox and source-section timing differences explicit.

stated_dates.date_note: No express revision/effective date established in reviewed text; URL dates not treated as legal dates.

review_scope.collected: Complete official profile HTML and linked two-page general proposed-order guide, extracted text and hashes.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts and recurring communication, scheduling, remote, cancellation, submission and basic case-management sections; shared guide format requirements.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Foreclosure merits/checklist and claim-specific prerequisites, detailed family proceedings, calendars, specimen order DOCX, remote-authority analysis. Shared AO link retained for later county applicability screening; no controlling-authority determination.
